## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Add coverage for adoption of an unchanged setting to protect its distinct change-recording behavior. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds an adoption mode that records existing incoming keys as changes and writes the configuration. It retains replacement behavior and adds tests for updating different values.

(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:13 — tests — Cover adoption of an unchanged setting — With `{"theme":"dark"}` already stored and the same incoming value, `adopt=True` records the key and rewrites the file, but no test exercises this boundary. The existing unchanged-value test covers only replacement. — A regression that skips recording unchanged adopted keys would pass the current suite. — Fix: Extend `test_adopt_updates_setting` with an unchanged-value case.
